designs.admission: all target global-read misses are eligible; protect below quota; at full quota protect only when replacing a local protected victim
designs.borrowing: ordinary lines borrow unused quota and may fall back to protected victims
designs.cuda_relation: does not model hitRatio fractional admission
designs.fairness: none; a recent class can occupy the whole pool
designs.metadata: protected/pending bit, target_class tag, global/per-subpartition occupancy and quota
designs.name: GLOBAL_ELASTIC_RECENCY
designs.quota: hard global bound distributed over subpartitions; no class share
designs.victim: invalid/normal/protected preference with baseline oldest protected victim; class ignored

designs.admission: a target line is protection-eligible only when stable_hash(class,line) is below the budget-specific fraction; failed/ineligible admission is ordinary and never stalls
designs.borrowing: unchanged ordinary borrowing and hard global bound
designs.complexity: low: one hash/threshold decision on target admission
designs.cuda_relation: direct modeling analogue of CUDA/PTX fractional eviction-priority assignment, but deterministic stability is an explicit simulator modeling decision
designs.fairness: statistical/stable opportunity fairness; limits one class injection but does not guarantee an exact occupancy floor
designs.metadata: existing target_class and line address plus one stable hash seed/threshold; no 28 occupancy counters
designs.name: GLOBAL_ELASTIC_FRACTIONAL_ADMISSION
designs.new_dimension: fractional target admission versus M1 all-target admission
designs.quota: global elastic quota; each class has an approximately equal, stable eligible subset of expected size global_quota/28

designs.admission: under-share classes may protect; over-share classes borrow only unused global capacity; at full quota protect only with a safe same-set victim
designs.borrowing: ordinary borrowing retained; target-class excess borrowing is reclaimable
designs.complexity: moderate: counters, share comparison, class-aware victim filtering
designs.cuda_relation: not an exposed CUDA guarantee; stronger than hitRatio and PTX fractional priority
designs.fairness: stronger proportional protection than M1F but still constrained by set-local victim availability
designs.metadata: existing per-line class plus 28 protected-occupancy counters per subpartition and soft-share accounting
designs.name: ELASTIC_PER_CLASS_SOFT_QUOTA
designs.ordinary_behavior: current ordinary preference/fallback can be retained
designs.quota: hard global bound plus soft per-class shares, no static way partition
designs.victim: prefer same-class or over-share protected victims; never evict an under-share class solely to admit an over-share class; otherwise fail safe unprotected

designs.admission: protect classes chosen by next-reuse utility
designs.fairness: not fairness; utility prioritization may intentionally be unequal
designs.metadata: per-class predicted/known next-reuse distance and selector state
designs.name: NEXT_REUSE_AWARE_CLASS_SELECTION
designs.victim: prefer classes with later predicted reuse
